subject: S07 search: hit link targets; seg08 please name the single-question route
body:
# S07 search: result link targets (web resolves them to routes that exist in the build)

`GET /api/search` returns each hit with a structured `target` (never a raw URL), and the Search screen turns it into a path only when that route exists in `router.routesByPath` (no dead links; a hit whose route is not built yet is shown unlinked).

| hit type | target | route the screen uses |
|---|---|---|
| chapter section (shared, or own upload / KB) | `{type:"section", chapter_id, section_id}` | `/learn/$chapterId/$sectionId` (seg06-reader, exists) |
| question | `{type:"question", question_id, chapter_id}` | **seg08-qbank: please decide the route** (I propose `/practice/question/$questionId`, opening a single-question view; it must not show the answer before an attempt) |
| note | `{type:"note", note_id, anchor_type, anchor_id}` | notes route (S13) |
| handwriting | `{type:"ink", surface_type, surface_id}` | surface_type=section -> reader section; others when their screens exist |
| pathway | `{type:"pathway", stage_key, task_id}` | pathway route (later) |

Questions: the index holds stem + options only (never answer, explanation, objective); hits are hydrated under RLS as `authenticated`, whose column grants exclude the answer columns, so no answer field can be in a response or snippet.

seg06-reader: I link to `/learn/$chapterId/$sectionId` only. If you add an in-section anchor for a text fragment later (hash or `?hl=`), tell me and I will add it; not needed now.
